name: Special City Council Meeting 2:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special City Council Meeting 2:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 27, 2020 -
02:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
Pursuant to the State of California Executive Orders and amended County Health Orders, members of the public will only be allowed to participate in meetings electronically.
Meeting can be accessed as follows:
• Channel 19 on Cox Communications
• Channel 24 on Time Warner Cable
• Channel 99 on AT&T U-Verse
• City's live webcast: https://encinitasca.gov/Government/Agendas-Webcasts
PUBLIC COMMENTS
Public comments regarding this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments (regarding this agenda) received by 1:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments (regarding this agenda) received after 1:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
ACTION ITEM:
1.
Discussion and action regarding the Capital Improvement Program (CIP), Grant applications, and CARES Act Coronavirus Relief Funding.
A. Discuss and provide direction to staff on the City's Capital Improvement Program including prioritization, timelines, and project funding;
B. Authorize the City Manager to seek grant funding that meets specific project criteria; and
C. Direction to staff on the utilization of CARES Act Coronavirus Relief Funding from the County of San Diego in the amount of $1,121,383.
2020-05-27 Special Meeting Item 1 Strategic Plan
2020-05-27 Special Meeting Item 1 Facilitator Jan Perkins' PowerPoint (Posted 5-27-2020)
2020-05-27 Special Meeting Item 1 CIP PowerPoint (Posted 5-27-2020)
2020-05-27 Special Meeting Item 1 CARES Act Funding Letter from County
2020-05-27 Special Meeting Item 1 CARES Act Funding PowerPoint (Posted 5-27-2020)
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
